anomalies.observed: U5.31 is on the LED3 net, which also connects to the keyboard's U4.23 LEDK_2_3 pin. The Q2 gate is connected to U5.31, so the keyboard LED control and EPD power-switch control share a net.
anomalies.expected: The EPD power-switch control should be independent of the keyboard LED3 control so that keyboard LED activity does not also control the display supply.

evidence.quote: SkylabModule.kicad_sch, page 2: U5 pin 31 is labeled LED3; U4 pin 23 (LEDK_2_3) is also labeled LED3, and the Q2 gate control connects to U5.31.
Display power-switch / leakage prevention: “Q2 is a high-side load switch gating the EPD panel's own power rail under SKW92A GPIO control.”

anomalies.impact: Driving the keyboard LED3 line can pull the P-channel MOSFET gate low and switch on the EPD power rail; conversely, EPD power control will also drive the keyboard LED3 connection. This couples keyboard LED behavior to display power and may cause unintended display power cycling or LED operation.

parsed.summary: The schematic appears to share the LED3 keyboard-control net with the EPD power-switch MOSFET gate. That couples keyboard LED activity to the display supply, contrary to the specified independently controlled display power switch.
